name: 激昂的牛头人
desc: ①：只要这张卡在怪兽区域存在，自己的兽族·兽战士族·鸟兽族怪兽向守备表示怪兽攻击的场合，给与对方攻击力超过那个守备力的数值的战斗伤害。
faq: For "Enraged Battle Ox"'s effect to activate, the attacked monster must be in Defense Position during damage calculation. So if "Final Attack Orders" is active, "Enraged Battle Ox"'s effect will not be applied.
